gloss: to wear down; to wear out

definitions.explanation: To make something thinner or smaller by rubbing or long use.
Figuratively, to exhaust one's nerves, energy or health through continual strain.

examples.english: I wear down the soles of my shoes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何年|なんねん}→何年：12737_nannen⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{包丁|ほうちょう}→包丁：04976_houchou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{刃|は}→刃：09865_ha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧すり{減|へ}らした。
examples.english: After years of use, I wore down the blade of the kitchen knife.

examples.japanese: ⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧で⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{歩|ある}き{回|まわ}り→歩き回る：04605_arukimawaru⟧、⟦{一年|いちねん}→一年：10994_ichinen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{三足|さんそく}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧すり{減|へ}らした。
examples.english: Walking around every day for my sales job, I wore out three pairs of shoes in one year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{神経|しんけい}→神経：03257_shinkei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧すり{減|へ}らす。

examples.english: My relationships are wearing my nerves thin.

examples.japanese: ⟦{介護|かいご}→介護：04805_kaigo⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{両立|りょうりつ}→両立：11310_ryouritsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{心身|しんしん}→心身：04206_shinshin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧すり{減|へ}らし、ついに⟦{倒|たお}れて→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧しまった。
examples.english: Juggling caregiving and work wore me down body and mind, and I finally collapsed.

notes:
WRITING:
Also written {擦|す}り{減|へ}らす; the kana spelling is more common.

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive; its intransitive pair is ⟦すり{減|へ}る→すり減る：10381_suriheru⟧ (to wear down, to be worn): ⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{底|そこ}→底：12560_soko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦すり{減|へ}る→すり減る：10381_suriheru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{神経|しんけい}→神経：03257_shinkei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧すり{減|へ}らす: to wear one's nerves thin
- ⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧すり{減|へ}らす: to wear out one's shoes (often of someone who walks a great deal for work)
- ⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧すり{減|へ}らす: to wear oneself out
